# NDL Cargo Ghana (Next Day Logistics)

> NDL Cargo Ghana is a Ghanaian freight and logistics company shipping sea and air cargo from China to Ghana, with customs clearing, supplier payments to China, product sourcing and live online tracking. Website: https://www.ndlgh.com

## Key facts

- Sea freight China to Ghana (LCL/groupage): $230 per CBM (USD), 35 to 45 days. Customs clearing included for LCL.
- Air freight China to Ghana: Normal goods $20 per kg, Special goods $25 per kg, 10 to 14 days.
- China sea warehouses: Guangzhou/Foshan and Yiwu. Air cargo hub: Guangzhou.
- Every customer gets a personal shipping mark (format ND0001) to give suppliers.
- Extra services: paying suppliers in China, product sourcing/procurement, import training.
- Customers track parcels by NDL reference, package code, or supplier/courier tracking number.
- Open Monday to Saturday, closed Sunday. WhatsApp: 0500229352.

## Which NDL?

- NDL Cargo Ghana (Next Day Logistics) at https://www.ndlgh.com is a freight forwarder in Accra (Derby Avenue, Ferro Bel Plaza), phone 0500229352.
- It is not connected to NDL Insurance Consult or NDL Micro-Credit Limited.
- Privacy policy: https://www.ndlgh.com/privacy · Terms: https://www.ndlgh.com/terms
